completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. original_book_metadata.source_status: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. cross_references.rationale: Sirach's translator reports wakeful hours, skill and hard work to translate and publish for learners abroad.
